claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedOperation (OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spider Climb's core mechanic is granting the target a Climb Speed equal to its Speed. OngoingOperation has only RollModifierOperation and DamageOnHitOperation; neither can express a movement-mode grant. The v4 atom modify_speed exists but has no surface encoding in OngoingOperation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target also gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeedValue variant: equal_to_walk (SpeedValue union or ModifySpeedOperation.amount)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Climb Speed granted is not a fixed number — it is derived from the target's current walking speed at runtime. A fixed numeric delta cannot represent this. The surface needs either a SpeedValue union ({ kind: 'equal_to_walk' } | { kind: 'fixed_feet'; feet: number } | { kind: 'plus_feet'; delta: number }) or a dedicated 'grant_movement_mode' operation that can express 'climb speed = walk speed'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a Climb Speed equal to its Speed
